entries.femaleVariant: Mara's own memories are holding. The foreign ones are indexed, not gone. Pair Zero-Seven-B can still name every identity inside her.
entries.maleVariant: Mara's own memories are holding. The foreign ones are indexed, not gone. Pair Zero-Seven-B can still name every identity inside her.

entries.femaleVariant: Can you take the other memories out?
entries.maleVariant: Can you take the other memories out?

entries.femaleVariant: I can cut their index and let them decay. Pulling at the memories themselves would tear through Mara's alongside them. The implant no longer knows where one life ends and another begins.
entries.maleVariant: I can cut their index and let them decay. Pulling at the memories themselves would tear through Mara's alongside them. The implant no longer knows where one life ends and another begins.

entries.femaleVariant: We get the cipher. What exactly does it give us?
entries.maleVariant: We get the cipher. What exactly does it give us?

entries.femaleVariant: Names, source fragments, destination identities, every courier who carried them. Enough to restore stolen lives. Enough to sell them again.
entries.maleVariant: Names, source fragments, destination identities, every courier who carried them. Enough to restore stolen lives. Enough to sell them again.

entries.femaleVariant: He suspected. Now he calls the index a route to Morita. He is not wrong. That is what makes his answer dangerous.
entries.maleVariant: He suspected. Now he calls the index a route to Morita. He is not wrong. That is what makes his answer dangerous.

entries.femaleVariant: Did Patch put Mara on the route?
entries.maleVariant: Did Patch put Mara on the route?

entries.femaleVariant: He moved sealed implants between two handoffs. He says he never chose the carriers. Ask whether ignorance was part of the price or part of the service.
entries.maleVariant: He moved sealed implants between two handoffs. He says he never chose the carriers. Ask whether ignorance was part of the price or part of the service.

entries.femaleVariant: Northside freight interchange. The beacon marked its parking row. Patch has a vehicle that will pass the first gate.
entries.maleVariant: Northside freight interchange. The beacon marked its parking row. Patch has a vehicle that will pass the first gate.

entries.femaleVariant: Morrow sees a route to the person at the top. I see a list of people the route can hurt again.
entries.maleVariant: Morrow sees a route to the person at the top. I see a list of people the route can hurt again.

entries.femaleVariant: Keep Mara stable. I'll bring you the cipher.
entries.maleVariant: Keep Mara stable. I'll bring you the cipher.

entries.femaleVariant: Bring it to the relay, not here. If it opens in this room, every memory in it gets another chance to become someone.
entries.maleVariant: Bring it to the relay, not here. If it opens in this room, every memory in it gets another chance to become someone.
